rules.sentence: Identify the characteristic clinical features and imaging findings associated with solitary fibrous tumors to facilitate prompt recognition and diagnosis.
Differentiate between solitary fibrous tumors and other soft tissue neoplasms based on histopathological examination and immunohistochemical staining patterns.

Implement evidence-based treatment strategies for solitary fibrous tumors, including surgical resection, radiation therapy, and systemic therapies, based on disease characteristics and patient preferences.
